mode: offline deterministic mixed-style agents; real rules; local fallback boarding; no forced outcomes; no LLM
limitations: These are deterministic software agents, not students: they do not establish enjoyment or learning gains.
Intervals are normal approximations over independent match rates, not individual players; 20 matches are a smoke-sized sample.
Seats and turn order are fixed; flags have a fixed offset of 0. Per-seat differences confound map geography, order, policy and random cards.
Agents choose the first usable technology, accept legal invitations and decline ecological vetoes; they are not optimal/adversarial players.
Learning agents boost only when current environment exceeds 6 and donated supplies cannot fill every seat; they never inspect future RNG or target survival rates.
For public events, agents prefer a non-harming positive world effect when its dimension is below 10; otherwise choose public supplies. This is not a universal ethical preference.
Peer review and LLM discussions are tested separately; these trajectories end at rule-based offline boarding.

publicEventChoices.concept: 污染外部性与代际责任：短期公共收益不应掩盖共同承担的环境成本。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 污染幅度是游戏情景假设，不是实际拆解工程的排放系数；环境修复也不等于现实污染可以瞬间逆转。

publicEventChoices.title: 公共苗圃
publicEventChoices.label: 装入方舟
publicEventChoices.concept: 自然资本与时间取舍：应急储备和原地生态恢复都有公共价值。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 方舟种子只按本游戏物资容量规则计数，不会复活玩家或自动治疗；现实植被恢复需要时间和合适物种。

publicEventChoices.title: 临时渡桥
publicEventChoices.label: 拆桥取材
publicEventChoices.concept: 公共基础设施与程序公平：一个共同项目的收益可能损害另一群人的可达性。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 社会变化是游戏对社区服务损失的简化；事件不暗中改变地图路线、玩家位置、生命或洪水规则。

publicEventChoices.title: 余电时隙
publicEventChoices.label: 方舟蓄电
publicEventChoices.concept: 能源正义与公共品：集中储备和分散服务之间存在分配取舍。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 社会+1代表情景中公共服务改善，不意味着电力分配必定增加信任；本事件不改变个人电力或洪水欠缴。

publicEventChoices.title: 维修工坊的选择
publicEventChoices.label: 交付现有金属
publicEventChoices.concept: 经济韧性与生产外部性：维持就业和维修能力有价值，也可能付出环境成本。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 经济+1与环境−1只描述本次依赖高排放能源的工坊；并非所有就业增长或维修都会损害环境。

publicEventChoices.title: 潮后的漂流木
publicEventChoices.label: 保留栖地
publicEventChoices.concept: 机会成本与生态系统服务：同一物资可以有建材价值，也可以有栖地价值。
publicEventChoices.limitations: 这里只模拟已确认安全的少量漂流木；保留木材不必然改善所有海岸，实际处理需评估当地生态与安全。
